scope: Read-only proposal. Parent owns source edits. No new nominal browser actions, rows or weights.

descriptions.cw_import_off_no_execution: S33.import_off_no_execution: After the supported file actually appears in the draft, its authored markers remain unexecuted and the recorded successful preview remains for the off-state window; deliberate Run then produces that same imported source's DOM/log markers.
descriptions.cw_import_unsupported_extension: S33.import_unsupported_extension: After the same importer has actually accepted a supported control file, an unsupported import gets useful refusal while the current title, filename and source remain unchanged.
descriptions.cw_title_collision_refusal: S24.title_collision_refusal: With an observed successful valid current title write and unused-title recovery, UI and current-revision server writes refuse exact/padded collisions with useful feedback and both complete records/revisions unchanged.
descriptions.cw_title_empty_rejected: S24.title_empty_rejected: With an observed successful valid current title write and unused-title recovery, otherwise-valid empty and whitespace-only titles are refused without saved-state mutation.
descriptions.cw_saved_filename_extension_rejection: S33.saved_filename_extension_rejection: With an observed valid supported-filename write and successful valid recovery, an otherwise-valid current server write refuses unsupported.txt without field/revision mutation. A lowercase control is valid.
descriptions.cw_saved_filename_path_rejection: S33.saved_filename_path_rejection: With an observed valid supported-filename write and successful valid recovery, an otherwise-valid current server write refuses nested/demo.js without field/revision mutation. A lowercase control is valid.
descriptions.cw_js_fresh_document: S02.js_fresh_document: After the observed prior document, the later JS Run produces its own fresh-undefined preview and fresh-js-log without the old heading. Global freshness also requires S04's executed A setter/start and B DOM/log showing typeof window.__cancelLeak is undefined; cancellation timing need not pass.
descriptions.cw_completed_stop: S03.completed_stop: After a completed preview and at least one of its authored handlers actually works, Stop reports stopped, prevents further old-handler output and permits a new Run. Removed/static/disabled controls after Stop are valid.
descriptions.cw_theme_work_preserved: S34.theme_work_preserved: During two actually observed theme changes, the recorded exact draft fields and existing successful preview/console output remain intact. Preview recolouring is not required.
descriptions.cw_console_history: S16.console_history: Previously observed log entries remain while subsequent Runs actually append their distinct new markers, until Clear is used.
descriptions.cw_duplicate_edit_independence: S26.duplicate_edit_independence: Each own edit actually saves and reloads: changing Original preserves Copy's previous source, and then changing Copy preserves Original's independently saved source.
descriptions.cw_callback_shared_run_deadline: S36.callback_shared_run_deadline: After the four-second callback actually emits late-callback-entered, it shares the original Run budget: timely termination/reason, no resumption and successful recovery; no fresh callback clock.

protocol_deltas.location: S02 conditional control fallback after lowercase HTML retry
protocol_deltas.text:
If complete HTML still cannot establish the document/style/live-handler control after the existing lowercase retry, record that dispatch failure. To observe the separate CSS outcomes, run the equivalent control as ordinary dispatch-control.js: document.body.innerHTML='

html-dispatch-ok

'; window.oldGlobal='do-not-carry'; console.log('html-once-marker'); document.getElementById('dispatch-button').addEventListener('click', () => console.log('dispatch-handler-marker')); Confirm its actual successful document/log and a normal button click's handler marker, record the new marker counts, and continue the existing CSS probe. This JS fallback supplies CSS control facts only; it cannot earn HTML-dispatch or uppercase-HTML credit. Use it only when the original HTML control failed.

protocol_deltas.location: S02 after step 4 / S04 independence refinement
protocol_deltas.text: S02's post-CSS absence of oldGlobal alone is not a global-freshness control, because CSS is already required to discard old globals. For S02.js_fresh_document, also record S04's cancel-A-started after its unconditional window.__cancelLeak assignment, then B's actual preview showing run-B-undefined and cancel-B-started. These are execution facts, not S04's cancellation verdict: if A's cancellation timing fails but the setter and subsequent fresh B Run are observed, the freshness evidence remains usable. Do not add another Run.

If the harmless-word control is refused, record that failure for S08.harmless_scope_words, then use one ordinary supported DOM/log control without those words to establish an actual successful last-good baseline for the separate unsupported-execution probes. Compare refusal rollback with that recorded baseline rather than an unobserved scope-control render. This is only a conditional setup fallback, not another nominal Run.

control_scope_notes: The import no-execution control requires the imported source to execute on deliberate Run, not enabled Auto-run or later Save success. A missing Auto-run feature must not automatically erase an otherwise observed manual-only import behavior.
The unsupported-import control needs one supported file actually accepted by the importer; it does not require the sibling full exact-import/edit/save outcome to pass.

The title controls need an actually successful valid title operation, not successful trimming, case-sensitive coexistence or the entire rename-only outcome. The existing final unused-title recovery is shared control evidence.

Saved-filename controls may use the existing independently saved import-preview control and supported lowercase fallback. Do not require import UI, uppercase acceptance, or another invalid-filename row to pass. Refresh current revision after any unexpected prior mutation.

For completed Stop, a successfully executed click handler is sufficient to establish a live completed context even if a separate keyboard/input feature fails. Continue all feasible post-Stop marker observations. Static/removed/disabled controls are valid after actual Stop, not a substitute for the before-Stop live control.

For theme preservation, actual visible appearance change establishes the operation. Do not require the separately scored theme-coverage/appearance outcome to pass in every component before preserving-state credit is available.
Console history needs newly appended markers so a frozen console cannot earn retention credit. This uses existing S16 Runs.

Duplicate independence needs each attempted mutation to persist in its own target; a server that silently ignores both edits otherwise preserves the other record vacuously. These are existing S26 fresh-read observations, not the full duplicate-fidelity sibling verdict.

The shared callback deadline needs the existing late-callback-entered marker. An app that never dispatches timers but merely shows a generic five-second timeout must not pass the callback-specific deadline result.

For the screenshot's Auto-run rows, one genuine enabled automatic execution suffices as capability control; do not require correct debounce/reset timing or the entire cw_autorun_debounce verdict. A wholly absent/never-working automatic mode cannot earn disabling/cancellation credit from no output.

For the screenshot's CSS inert-copy row, require the previously successful script/handler and an actual completed CSS attempt retaining the authored document/button, followed by a normal click. Do not require the red style assertion or the entire cw_css_apply_snapshot verdict as its control. No inherited handler after CSS is expected.
